projectDescription: A seven-agent orchestration pipeline that automates the documentation lifecycle — from product change events through impact analysis, content drafting, human approval, quality review, and governance reporting.
keyFeatures: Seven-agent orchestration pipeline for documentation lifecycle automation
Deterministic triage layer with zero LLM — eight rule-based detectors for auditable routing
Semantic impact analysis using vector search across the documentation corpus
Structured DIFF package output for human-reviewable content proposals
Mandatory human approval gate before any content reaches production
Parallel quality review sub-agents evaluating 77 rules across prose, style, and terminology
Full governance and audit logging for every pipeline run
78% token reduction via Skills-type agent architecture
publicApiSurface: Routing manifest (8 detectors: detect_change_type, detect_scope, detect_audience, detect_urgency, detect_notify_trigger, detect_content_trigger, detect_review_trigger, detect_escalation_trigger)
Impact manifest (affected pages with severity scores and change rationale)
DIFF package (current_content, proposed_content, change_rationale, confidence, dependencies)
Findings payload (rule_id, category, severity, location, suggested_text, confidence)
Run log (routing_manifest, agents_dispatched, impact_summary, approval_event, quality_summary, token_consumption)
MCP tool categories: Retrieval, Write, Search, Metadata, Notification
